key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:7A2E
name: store_unique_position_entry
description: Scans a table of position records spaced 25 words apart and returns early if the current coordinates already match an entry. When no entry matches, it writes the record's flag and shifted coordinates into fixed global cells.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:7A92
name: dispatch_pending_state_command
description: Reads a pending command byte from the game state block, clears it, and switches on it to run one of many handlers. Several handlers adjust clamped accumulator values, and some call routines through function pointers stored in the state block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:7B4E
name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting of a single return with no calls, memory access or hardware use. It is only referenced as a handler pointer and performs no work.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8150
name: reset_handler_state_with_result
description: Clears the pending command byte and, when the guard flag is zero, calls two hook routines through the state block. It then resets the mode variables, installs the handler pointers and returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:816C
name: reset_handler_state_guarded
description: Clears the pending command byte and, when the guard flag is zero, calls two hook routines through the state block. It then resets the mode variables and installs the handler pointers without returning a value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:81C6
name: reset_handler_state_then_notify
description: Clears the pending command byte and, when the guard flag is zero, calls one hook through the state block. It then resets the mode variables, installs the handler pointers and calls a further routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:821C
name: start_sequence_when_idle
description: Clears the pending command byte. When the sequence flag is clear it fills several global cells and starts a sequence only if the sequence and guard flags are both zero, otherwise it records a counter and calls a routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:82B4
name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting of a single return with no calls, memory access or hardware use. It is only referenced as a handler pointer and performs no work.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:82B6
name: reinstall_handler_pointers_and_reset
description: Clears the pending command byte and, when the guard flag is zero, calls a routine and a hook through the state block. It then resets the mode variables and installs handler pointers, with the last pointer set to a global data cell.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8310
name: reset_form_handler_state
description: Clears the pending command byte and, when the guard flag is zero, runs a hook and resets the mode variables. It installs handler pointers and a table pointer chosen from the state block, and the referenced text FORM marks it as the form handler.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:836C
name: reset_form_handler_state
description: Clears the pending command byte and, when the guard flag is zero, runs a hook and resets the mode variables. It installs handler pointers and a table pointer chosen from the state block, and the referenced text FORM marks it as the form handler.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:83C8
name: reset_handler_state_with_hook
description: Clears the pending command byte and, when the guard flag is zero, clears a state word and runs a hook before resetting the mode variables. It then installs the handler pointers and a fill-value pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8420
name: reset_form_state_with_pointer
description: Clears the pending command byte and, when the guard flag is zero, resets the mode variables and runs a hook. It installs handler pointers and, when a flag word in the state block is set, stores a fill-value pointer into a field of the state.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:848E
name: reset_handler_state_basic
description: Clears a state word, runs a hook when the guard flag is zero, then resets the mode variables and installs the handler pointers. It sets the fill-value pointer and the table pointer from the state block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:84E6
name: reset_handler_state_basic
description: Clears a state word, runs a hook when the guard flag is zero, then resets the mode variables and installs the handler pointers. It sets the fill-value pointer and the table pointer from the state block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:853E
name: reset_handler_state_basic
description: Clears a state word, runs a hook when the guard flag is zero, then resets the mode variables and installs the handler pointers. It sets the fill-value pointer and the table pointer from the state block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8596
name: capture_position_and_reset_state
description: When the guard flag is zero it reads a value from a hook and compares it with a threshold. If the threshold is exceeded it sets a state flag, otherwise it records the current position values and resets the handler state.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:85DA
name: capture_position_for_sequence
description: Records the current position and size values into sequence cells, clears a state flag, then runs a hook and resets the handler pointers. It sets the stage marker to two.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8648
name: start_blitter_copy_transfer
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, then clears its modulo and shift registers and programs a copy mode with a full first-word mask. It sets the source and destination pointers from the state block, starts a fixed-size transfer and then calls a routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8708
name: queue_blitter_copy_parameters
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, then loads the source pointer from the state block and clears the blitter modulo and shift registers. It programs a copy mode and a fixed-size transfer size before returning.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:875E
name: save_handler_pointers_and_dispatch
description: Clears a pending slot if one is set, then copies three pointer values from the state block into global cells. It finishes by calling a routine through a function pointer stored in the state block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8796
name: restore_saved_handler_pointers
description: When a saved-slot flag is set, it writes a sentinel value into the three saved locations and restores their pointers into the state block. It then copies sixteen words from the state block into global cells.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:87E4
name: cycle_mode_and_format_text
description: Advances a three-step counter and, on wrap-around, resets the mode state and sets a display flag. Otherwise it fills a 48-character buffer with spaces, uppercases its text, centres the string and calls a routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:882A
name: call_two_routines_store_pointer
description: Calls two routines and then stores a routine pointer into a fixed data cell. It has no other effect.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:884C
name: clear_mode_counter_and_arm
description: Calls two routines and clears a mode counter, then clears the pending command byte. When the sequence flag is clear and the guard is zero it sets the mode state and handler pointers, otherwise it marks a display field and calls a routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:887A
name: format_framerate_text_line
description: When an enabled flag in the state block is set, it fills a 48-character buffer with spaces, uppercases its text and centres it before calling a routine. The referenced text includes frame-rate labels, so this formats a frame-rate readout.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:88AC
name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting of a single return with no calls, memory access or hardware use. It performs no work.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:88CE
name: cycle_target_label_and_format
description: Clears the pending command byte, then advances a counter that wraps at three. It fills a 48-character buffer with spaces, uppercases its text, centres the string and calls a routine. The referenced text names friendly airbase and waypoint labels.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8900
name: format_secondary_target_label
description: Calls a routine, then fills a 48-character buffer with spaces, uppercases its text and centres it. Over-long text is cut off with a full stop, and a display field is set to 40 before a further routine is called. The referenced text is the label for a secondary target.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8906
name: format_primary_target_label
description: Calls a routine, then fills a 48-character buffer with spaces, uppercases its text and centres it. Over-long text is cut off with a full stop, and a display field is set to 40 before a further routine is called. The referenced text is the label for a primary target.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:894E
name: toggle_autopilot_timer_text
description: Clears the pending command byte and sets a timer to the larger of 1000 and a state value, or to zero when it is already set. It then fills and centres a 48-character text line and calls a routine. The referenced text is the autopilot label.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:897A
name: arm_autopilot_engaged_text
description: Sets a timer to the larger of 1000 and a state value, clears a flag and fills a centred text line. It then calls a routine, and the referenced text is the engaged status label.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:89C0
name: decrement_state_word_and_flag
description: Clears the pending command byte, subtracts 32768 from a state word and sets a flag byte in the state block to all ones.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:89D8
name: reset_starting_values_if_active
description: Clears the pending command byte and, when a state word is nonzero, sets a value to 10000. It also resets several counters to fixed starting values and sets four global cells to all ones.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:89E4
name: reset_starting_values
description: Sets a value to 10000, resets several counters to fixed starting values and sets four global cells to all ones. The referenced text 9999 is an initial display default.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8A46
name: increase_stored_value_capped
description: Clears the pending command byte and raises a stored value by 5 when it is below 10, otherwise by 10. The result is capped at 100, and a counter and a global cell are cleared.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8A56
name: set_stored_value_plus_ten
description: Sets a stored value to the input word plus 10, capped at 100. It then clears the pending command byte, a counter and a global cell.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8A7C
name: decrease_stored_value_floored
description: Clears the pending command byte and subtracts 10 from a stored value. The result is floored at zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8A96
name: set_stored_value_to_hundred
description: Clears the pending command byte, sets a stored value to 100 and clears a counter. It also sets a global cell to all ones.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8AB6
name: clear_stored_value_pending
description: Clears the pending command byte and sets a stored value to zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8AC2
name: set_stored_value_to_144
description: Clears the pending command byte, sets a stored value to 144 and clears a counter. It also sets a global cell to all ones.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8ADC
name: increase_wrapping_accumulator_first
description: When a state word is nonzero, adds a step to a first accumulator. The step is 131072 shifted right by a level counter, and the sum is wrapped back by one step when it exceeds 1048575.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8B12
name: decrease_floored_accumulator_first
description: When a state word is nonzero, subtracts a level-scaled step from a first accumulator. The result is clamped to a floor of 16384.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8B48
name: increase_wrapping_accumulator_second
description: When a state word is nonzero, adds a step to a second accumulator. The step is 131072 shifted right by a level counter, and the sum is wrapped back by one step when it exceeds 1048575.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8B78
name: decrease_floored_accumulator_second
description: When a state word is nonzero, subtracts a level-scaled step from a second accumulator. The result is clamped to a floor of 16384.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8BB0
name: update_damped_value_or_step
description: When a state word is zero, reduces a value by a quarter of itself divided by a divisor, clamped at a minimum of 500 when a flag byte is non-negative. Otherwise it clears the pending command byte, advances a step index and walks the entry list, or resets the index to 9 when it reaches 10.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8BD6
name: decay_value_clamped_at_minimum
description: When a flag byte is non-negative, reduces a value by a quarter of itself divided by a divisor and clamps the result to a minimum of 500.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8BDC
name: walk_entry_list_calling_unflagged
description: Walks a list of entries whose length comes from a count word, calling a routine for each entry whose flag bits are clear. It then calls two further routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8C08
name: grow_value_or_decrement_index
description: When a state word is zero, increases a value by a quarter of itself divided by a divisor, clamped at a maximum of 20000 when a flag byte is non-negative. Otherwise it clears the pending command byte, decrements a step index and walks the entry list, resetting the index to 2 when it reaches 1.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8C2E
name: walk_entry_list_calling_unflagged
description: Walks a list of entries whose length comes from a count word, calling a routine for each entry whose flag bits are clear. It then calls two further routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8C34
name: grow_value_clamped_at_maximum
description: When a flag byte is non-negative, increases a value by a quarter of itself divided by a divisor and clamps the result to a maximum of 20000.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8C60
name: clear_audio_sample_buffer
description: Clears the pending command byte, sets a flag and fills a 128-byte buffer with the midpoint value of an unsigned sample. It zeroes four global cells and calls two routines through the state block, and the audio volume registers it references suggest it silences the four audio channels.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8CB6
name: cycle_range_setting_and_format
description: Clears the pending command byte and advances a three-step counter that wraps to zero. It fills a 48-character buffer with spaces, uppercases its text, centres it and calls a routine, and the referenced text names a long-range label.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8CD8
name: format_medium_range_label
description: Calls two routines, then fills a 48-character buffer with spaces, uppercases its text and centres it. Over-long text is cut off with a full stop, a display field is set to 40 and a routine is called. The referenced text is the medium label.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8CEA
name: format_radar_range_label
description: Calls two routines, then fills a 48-character buffer with spaces, uppercases its text and centres it. Over-long text is cut off with a full stop, a display field is set to 40 and a routine is called. The referenced text covers the range radar and short labels.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8D30
name: select_sidewinder_weapon_mode
description: Clears the pending command byte, sets a weapon selection index to zero and sets a weapon flag to one. It then calls routines that refresh the weapon display, and the referenced text covers armed and not-available labels for the sidewinder missile.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8D6C
name: select_amraam_weapon_mode
description: Clears the pending command byte, sets a weapon selection index to zero and clears a weapon flag. It then calls routines that refresh the weapon display, and the referenced text covers armed and not-available labels for the AMRAAM missile.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8DA6
name: select_maverick_weapon_mode
description: Clears the pending command byte, sets a weapon selection index to one and a weapon flag to two. It then calls routines that refresh the weapon display, and the referenced text covers the maverick label and its not-available state.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8DDA
name: refresh_weapon_display_when_active
description: When a state word is nonzero, calls four routines to refresh the display. A saved global value is kept across those calls and restored afterwards.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8E56
name: dispatch_three_saved_slot_values
description: Stores three state-block words in turn into a shared global cell and calls a routine after each store. It returns the register pair it was given.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8EE4
name: fire_weapon_into_free_slot
description: Clears the pending command byte and, when a magnitude value is below 12289 and two flags are clear, scans two entries for a free slot. It then calls the launch routine selected by the weapon index from the jump table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8F3E
name: queue_type_two_event_record
description: When its count is nonzero, decrements the count and fills a 16-word record with a type code, a fixed value and the current state values. It stores the record address, calls four routines and arms a timer when a level flag and a limit are met.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8F66
name: queue_type_three_event_record
description: When its count is nonzero, decrements the count and fills a 16-word record with a type code, a fixed value and the current state values. It stores the record address, calls four routines and arms a timer when a level flag and a limit are met.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8F94
name: queue_type_one_event_record
description: When its count is nonzero, decrements the count and fills a 16-word record with a type code, a fixed value and the current state values. It stores the record address, calls four routines and arms a timer when a level flag and a limit are met.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:8FF2
name: fill_event_record_from_source
description: Copies values from a source record into a 16-word destination record and fills the rest from current state values. It stores the destination address, calls four routines and arms a timer when a level flag and a limit are met. The referenced text is fired, so this records a launch event.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9086
name: toggle_flag_and_set_display
description: Clears the pending command byte and toggles a flag between zero and one. It sets a global cell to all ones, and when the flag becomes zero it also sets a display field to 1.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:90A4
name: toggle_flag_with_threshold_check
description: Clears the pending command byte. When a stored value differs from another value, it toggles an indicator flag unless that flag is already set and a second value exceeds 350, and it sets a global cell to all ones.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:90CA
name: toggle_indicator_flag_and_mark
description: Toggles an indicator flag between zero and one and sets a global cell to all ones.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:90DA
name: invert_toggle_word_and_clear
description: Clears the pending command byte and inverts a toggle word in place.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:90E6
name: record_slot_and_decrement_count
description: When a remaining count is nonzero and a tracked value has changed, it saves the current values into the first free record of seven entries and calls a routine. It then subtracts a step from the count and decrements a four-digit ASCII display to match, clearing both when the count goes negative. The referenced text 9999 is the upper display limit.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:929A
name: select_best_scoring_target_entry
description: Chooses a target entry by scanning two lists of records and keeping the entry with the highest score within a distance limit. The first list uses records 43 words apart with a limit of 8192, and the second uses records 25 words apart with a limit of 6144. The chosen entry is stored in a global pointer and returned.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:92AC
name: format_build_stamp_text_line
description: When a state flag is set, it fills a 48-character buffer with spaces, uppercases its text and centres it before calling a routine. The referenced text is a build timestamp, so this shows the assembly date line.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:92CA
name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting of a single return with no calls, memory access or hardware use. It performs no work.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:92EC
name: format_stores_exhausted_message
description: Calls a routine, then fills a 48-character buffer with spaces, uppercases its text and centres it. Over-long text is cut off with a full stop, a display field is set to 40 and a routine is called. The referenced text is the stores exhausted message.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:92F8
name: release_flare_and_show_message
description: When a flare count is nonzero, it decrements the count, records the current position and a computed offset, then calls a routine. Otherwise it calls a routine directly, and it then formats the referenced text FLARE RELEASED for display.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9346
name: release_chaff_and_show_message
description: When a chaff count is nonzero, it decrements the count, records the current position and a computed offset, then calls a routine. Otherwise it calls a routine directly, and it then formats the referenced text CHAFF RELEASED for display.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9394
name: cycle_detail_level_digit
description: Clears the pending command byte and steps a detail digit downward, wrapping it to 2 after 0 and resetting a counter when it wraps. It then formats the buffer text and calls a routine. The referenced text is the detail level label.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9406
name: cycle_sound_mode_and_format
description: Advances a sound-mode counter in the state block and sets the mode flags for each value, calling a sound routine through the state block. It then formats the buffer text and calls a routine, and the referenced text includes engine sound off.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:944E
name: enable_sound_effects_and_format
description: Calls a sound routine through the state block, resets a sound counter and sets the sound flags. It then formats the referenced text sound effects on and calls a routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:947C
name: silence_all_sound_and_format
description: Sets a sound flag to all ones and calls a routine through the state block. It then formats the referenced text all sound off and calls a routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9492
name: enable_music_one_and_format
description: Sets three music-state flags, calls a sound routine through the state block and then formats the referenced text Music 1 for display. It finishes by calling a further routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:94B4
name: enable_music_two_and_format
description: Sets three music-state flags, calls a sound routine through the state block and then formats the referenced text Music 2 for display. It finishes by calling a further routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9518
name: invoke_state_callback_pass_through
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer stored in the state block and returns the register pair it was given.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:952A
name: call_routine_pass_through
description: Calls one routine and returns the register pair it was given.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:953C
name: call_handler_with_saved_word
description: Clears the pending command byte, saves a state word and calls a routine through the state block. It waits while a status byte is set, then writes two global cells and restores the saved word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:959A
name: clear_pending_and_call_handler
description: Clears the pending command byte and calls a routine through a function pointer in the state block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:95A4
name: cycle_control_sensitivity_level
description: Clears the pending command byte and advances a control sensitivity digit that wraps from 3 back to 1. It then formats the referenced text control sensitivity and calls a routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:95F0
name: cycle_control_index_and_store
description: Clears the pending command byte and advances a two-bit index. It stores the table value at that index into a state pointer, calls routines and formats a text line.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:95F2
name: cycle_control_method_text
description: Clears the pending command byte and advances a two-bit index. It stores the indexed table value into a state pointer, then calls routines and formats the referenced text control method.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9686
name: draw_heading_scale_marks
description: Wraps a stored angle value by 360 and splits it into steps of 45 units. It selects a table entry for the current step and ORs bit patterns into a block of raster words at offsets set by the position within the step, with the step count wrapping at eight.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:96BA
name: draw_countdown_overlay_short
description: Calls four routines, then, while a countdown value is positive, decrements it and ORs bit patterns from four tables into raster rows. The overlay is redrawn each time the routine runs.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:96F0
name: draw_countdown_overlay_full
description: Calls five routines, then, while a countdown value is positive, decrements it and ORs bit patterns from four tables into raster rows. Each row pattern is taken from a state-block table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9798
name: draw_countdown_overlay_alt
description: Calls six routines, then, while a countdown value is positive, decrements it and ORs bit patterns from four tables into raster rows. Each row pattern is taken from a state-block table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9834
name: draw_overlay_for_selected_target
description: Selects one of two target pointers using a weapon mode flag, and skips the block when that pointer is negative. It then calls several routines and runs the countdown overlay bit-pattern block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9862
name: draw_overlay_for_second_target
description: Calls routines depending on the sign of the second target pointer, then runs the countdown overlay bit-pattern block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:999E
name: load_target_and_draw_overlay
description: Copies position values from the selected target record into shared globals, calls routines and then runs the countdown overlay bit-pattern block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:99F0
name: load_second_target_position_overlay
description: Copies shifted position values from the second target into shared globals, calls routines and then runs the countdown overlay bit-pattern block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9B3E
name: draw_countdown_overlay_compact
description: Calls four routines, then, while a countdown value is positive, decrements it and ORs bit patterns from four tables into raster rows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9B6E
name: draw_countdown_overlay_entry
description: Entry point into the countdown overlay block. It calls four routines, then, while a countdown value is positive, decrements the value and ORs bit patterns into raster rows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9B72
name: draw_countdown_overlay_entry_alt
description: Second entry point into the countdown overlay block. It calls four routines, then, while a countdown value is positive, decrements the value and ORs bit patterns into raster rows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9B76
name: draw_countdown_overlay_mid
description: Calls four routines, then, while a countdown value is positive, decrements it and ORs bit patterns from four tables into raster rows. It is a midpoint entry into the same overlay block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9BB2
name: program_blitter_then_draw_overlay
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, then programs its mode, masks, modulo values and source and destination pointers from the state block. It starts a fixed-size transfer and then runs the countdown overlay bit-pattern block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9C60
name: draw_countdown_overlay_late
description: Calls five routines, then, while a countdown value is positive, decrements it and ORs bit patterns from four tables into raster rows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9C9C
name: draw_countdown_overlay_by_record
description: Calls five routines chosen by whether the first word of a record is zero, then runs the countdown overlay bit-pattern block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9D52
name: draw_countdown_overlay_wide
description: Calls five routines, then, while a countdown value is positive, decrements it and ORs bit patterns from four tables into raster rows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9D9C
name: advance_timed_string_copy
description: Counts down a timer. When it runs out, it either resets a display and state cells or chooses a 50-byte record and copies its zero-terminated string into a global buffer. The referenced text F-15 Strike Eagle is one of the strings it works with.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9DF2
name: select_record_string_and_draw
description: Looks up a 50-byte record by index and copies its zero-terminated string into a global buffer when the record's flag is set. Otherwise it marks the buffer empty, then clears a state word and runs the countdown overlay bit-pattern block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9E3A
name: find_flagged_record_copy_string
description: Searches up to eleven 86-byte records for one with bit 2 set in a flag byte. When one is found it copies that record's zero-terminated string into a global buffer, and when none is found it marks the buffer empty before drawing the overlay block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9E42
name: search_patrol_record_and_copy
description: Searches 86-byte records for one with bit 2 set in a flag byte, repeating up to a count held in a register. When one is found it copies its string into a global buffer and runs the countdown overlay bit-pattern block. The referenced text on patrol is a status label.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9EB4
name: enable_dma_and_draw_heading
description: Resets sound and display state, then writes a DMA control value that sets the enable bit for DMA channels. It runs the same 360-unit heading computation as the heading scale routine, ORing bit patterns into raster words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9F5A
name: draw_countdown_overlay_extended
description: Calls nine routines, then, while a countdown value is positive, decrements it and ORs bit patterns from four tables into raster rows. It is the extended form of the countdown overlay block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A04E
name: draw_countdown_overlay_guarded
description: Clears a state word, and when a second state word is nonzero it resets the first state word and calls routines. It then runs the countdown overlay bit-pattern block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A100
name: draw_countdown_overlay_gated
description: Clears a state word, and when a second state word is nonzero it resets the first state word and calls routines. It then runs the countdown overlay bit-pattern block with a different call sequence.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A1E0
name: copy_capture_and_draw_overlay
description: Copies three saved position values into working cells and calls routines. When a stored value differs from another it calls one more routine, then runs the countdown overlay bit-pattern block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A1E4
name: copy_capture_and_draw_tail
description: Copies three saved position values into working cells and calls routines. When a stored value differs from another it calls one more routine, then runs the tail of the countdown overlay bit-pattern block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A2B6
name: update_sprite_control_pointers
description: When a state word is nonzero, it computes sprite positions from two stored values using division and remainders. It writes control words into sprite data blocks, saves the words they replace and updates the sprite pointer hardware registers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A3A2
name: position_sprite_block_from_value
description: Converts an input value into a block offset by dividing it by ten and adding four when the remainder exceeds four. It writes a control word into the block, saves the words it replaces and copies position values into state cells.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A46C
name: clear_sprite_control_words
description: Writes zero into two control words referenced from the state block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A47C
name: copy_sprite_offsets_when_active
description: When a state word is nonzero, copies two stored values from the state block into an output block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A492
name: call_two_then_store_word
description: Calls two routines and stores the word passed in a data register into a fixed global cell.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A4CA
name: copy_sprite_state_block_values
description: Copies six state-block words into global cells in a fixed order. The sprite pointer references suggest these values feed the eight sprite channels.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A50C
name: copy_alternate_sprite_state_values
description: Copies five state-block words and one further state word into global cells in a fixed order. The sprite pointer references suggest these values feed the sprite channels.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A54E
name: update_sprite_control_when_idle
description: When a timer word is zero, it writes sprite control words and computes sprite offsets from two stored values. The offsets use division by five and ten with fixed additions, and the words that are overwritten are saved.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A55A
name: replicate_state_word_to_globals
description: Copies one state-block word into eight global cells. The sprite pointer references suggest it refreshes sprite data.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A58C
name: copy_second_sprite_state_group
description: Copies four state-block words and one further state word into global cells. The sprite pointer references suggest these values feed sprite data.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A606
name: scan_entry_lists_and_update
description: Scans three lists of entries. Flagged records are passed to a routine, active records are passed to a routine, and records within 16384 units of a stored position are passed to a routine. It then adds 400 to a stored value when a counter condition holds.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A870
name: update_palette_countdown_or_load
description: Decrements a countdown. While it is nonzero it calls a routine and copies two saved values, and when it reaches zero it loads sixteen words from a table into the colour hardware registers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A878
name: update_palette_countdown_or_load
description: Decrements a countdown. While it is nonzero it calls a routine and copies two saved values, and when it reaches zero it loads sixteen words from a table into the colour hardware registers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A912
name: transform_point_relative_to_camera
description: Computes the offset of a state position from a reference position and returns early when any component exceeds 16384. Otherwise it applies a fixed three-by-three matrix of stored coefficients to the scaled offset.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A94A
name: evaluate_target_engagement_conditions
description: Tests range and state conditions for a selected target. It calls two routines when the range and status checks pass, and sets a status flag when the weapon mode and distance limits are met.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:AB20
name: reset_state_values_to_defaults
description: Zeroes a block of game state values, sets a display counter to 10000 and sets default position values. It fills a sixteen-entry table with current accumulator values, and the referenced text 0000 is the default display string.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:AC72
name: update_input_derived_state
description: Converts two packed input words into signed values by shifting and offsetting them, then applies flag checks that trigger status routines. The referenced text covers brakes and landing gear messages, so it also updates those status lines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:BDCE
name: update_axis_fields_from_byte
description: Returns early when two linked pointers match. Otherwise it extracts a two-bit and a four-bit field from a state byte and updates two stored words, resetting them to 127 when a field changes.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:BEBE
name: interpolate_angle_from_table
description: Stores three current values, reads a new value and wraps it when it jumps by more than 8192. It linearly interpolates between neighbouring entries of a lookup table, and when the result is zero it sets two values from sign tests on stored flags.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:BEC2
name: interpolate_angle_with_branches
description: Stores three current values, reads a new value and wraps it when it jumps by more than 8192. It linearly interpolates between neighbouring entries of a lookup table, then branches on sign tests of stored flags to set the final values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1B0
name: interpolate_table_pairs_for_outputs
description: Interpolates between neighbouring entries of two lookup tables for three index values. It produces several interpolated outputs that other routines use as building blocks.

description: Multiplies pairs of stored coefficients by stored scale values, rounds each sum to a 16-bit result and stores the results in output cells. It performs a fixed-point matrix product in several steps and calls four routines.

name: multiply_rotation_matrix_alt
description: Multiplies pairs of stored coefficients by stored scale values using a second coefficient set, rounds each sum to a 16-bit result and stores the results in output cells. It calls four routines.

name: multiply_rotation_matrix_partial
description: Multiplies coefficient pairs by scale values, rounding each result and storing it in output cells. It completes part of a fixed-point matrix product and calls six routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C79A
name: compute_restoring_fixed_quotient
description: Takes the magnitude of an input word and runs an eight-step restoring loop. It produces a fixed-point quotient-like result, returned as a packed pair of words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C7C4
name: divide_signed_fixed_values
description: Divides a signed value by a divisor, handling the signs of both operands separately. It returns the quotient and remainder packed into one result, and it returns the high word unchanged when the divisor is zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C820
name: subtract_result_from_16384
description: Calls one routine and returns 16384 minus its result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C82C
name: lookup_inverse_table_index
description: Takes the magnitude of an input word and finds its position in a sorted table, starting from a coarse index taken from a second table. It reapplies the sign and returns the index scaled by 32.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C862
name: check_base_landing_proximity
description: Checks whether the position lies within limits of a base record, using bands that widen with a record flag. When inside, it sets an in-range flag, and when further range and flag tests pass it clears stored counters and sets status flags. The referenced text covers takeoff, landing and weapon replenishment messages.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:D0CE
name: draw_heading_scale_marks_full
description: Sets a status bit and calls six routines. It then computes a wrapped angle from a stored value by multiplying by 360 and splitting it into 45-unit steps, ORing pattern words into raster rows for each tick.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:D0F2
name: update_target_readout_display
description: Toggles a flag. On one phase it programs blitter registers for a fixed-size transfer, and on the other it reads the selected target record, copies its position fields and fills display fields. The referenced text covers missile lock, primary, no target and secondary labels, so it selects the target status readout.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:D82A
name: start_blitter_block_transfer
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, sets a destination offset from the state block and starts a fixed-size block transfer using the blitter mode registers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:DA0E
name: set_bit_and_interpolate_outputs
description: Sets a bit in a memory word at a computed address and advances a counter. When the counter wraps it waits for the blitter and starts a transfer, otherwise it interpolates table values into two output cells.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:DA2C
name: gate_blitter_transfer_with_interpolation
description: Advances a counter that gates blitter transfers. When the gate opens it waits for the blitter and programs its offset, otherwise it interpolates table values and loops over several entries to build a mask.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:DEF2
name: shift_and_merge_raster_rows
description: Checks that two coordinates fall inside a window between 120 and 174 units. It then shifts five source words by a bit offset and merges them into raster rows using a mask, repeating for seven row groups.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:DFB0
name: compute_relative_screen_offset
description: Computes the difference of two scaled coordinate projections relative to the current reference position. It adds a fixed offset of 146 and returns the result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E00C
name: start_blitter_offset_transfer
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, programs its source and destination pointers from state values and starts a fixed-size transfer. It returns its input byte unchanged.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E068
name: start_blitter_mode_transfer
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, sets a destination offset from the state block, writes its mode and size registers and starts a transfer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E0A6
name: build_object_record_octant
description: Computes the absolute horizontal and vertical distances to a reference point and orders them. It selects a code from a four-entry jump table by comparing signs, then writes size and offset words into an object record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E0AA
name: build_object_record_octant_entry
description: Computes the absolute horizontal and vertical distances to a reference point and orders them. It selects a code from a four-entry jump table by comparing signs, then writes size and offset words into an object record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E0AE
name: build_object_record_octant_tail
description: Computes the absolute horizontal and vertical distances to a reference point and orders them. It selects a code from a four-entry jump table by comparing signs, then writes size and offset words into an object record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E0B2
name: build_object_record_octant_table
description: Computes the absolute horizontal and vertical distances to a reference point and orders them. It reads a code from a byte table by comparing signs, then writes size and offset words into an object record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E0BC
name: build_object_record_octant_direct
description: Computes the absolute horizontal and vertical distances to a reference point and orders them. It selects a code from a four-entry jump table by comparing signs, then writes size and offset words into an object record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E16A
name: project_point_set_for_drawing
description: Waits for the blitter, then draws entries flagged for display. It projects a set of points by multiplying table values by a scale and writes the resulting coordinate pairs to output cells in a loop.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E21E
name: start_blitter_source_transfer
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, sets the source pointer from a state word and a destination offset, then starts a fixed-size transfer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E276
name: start_blitter_source_transfer_alt
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, sets the source pointer from a state word and a destination offset, then starts a fixed-size transfer with the source and destination roles swapped.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E3CE
name: build_screen_object_record
description: Computes two screen coordinates from offsets against a reference point. It waits for the blitter, derives an octant-style code and writes size and offset words into an object record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E3D2
name: build_screen_object_record_entry
description: Entry point that computes two screen coordinates from offsets against a reference point. It derives an octant-style code and writes size and offset words into an object record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E3D6
name: build_screen_object_record_inner
description: Inner entry point that computes two screen coordinates from offsets against a reference point. It derives an octant-style code and writes size and offset words into an object record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E3DA
name: build_screen_object_record_offset
description: Builds an object record from coordinates offset by 79 and 154 from a reference point. It computes an octant-style code and size words, and waits for the blitter before writing them.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E432
name: initialize_object_table_for_frame
description: Copies the current position and several reference values into shared cells. It then fills an eight-entry object table with words derived from the position plus 32, calling seven routines to set up the entries.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E852
name: copy_flagged_entry_list
description: Looks up an entry from a table indexed by the low seven bits of its input and returns early when its fields are not set. Otherwise it copies a list of entries, writing marker values for those flagged negative, then calls routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E9BE
name: scale_position_and_refresh_entries
description: Converts two position values to coarse values by shifting them right by five. It walks the entry list, calling a routine for each entry with clear flag bits, and then calls two further routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E9C2
name: scale_position_and_refresh_tail
description: Converts two position values to coarse values by shifting them right by five. It walks the entry list, calling a routine for each entry with clear flag bits, and then calls two further routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E9DE
name: refresh_entry_list_tail
description: Walks the entry list, calling a routine for each entry with clear flag bits, and then calls two further routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:EA26
name: start_blitter_pair_offset_transfer
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, sets source and destination pointers from two offset bases, and starts a fixed-size transfer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:EA7E
name: dispatch_if_inside_bounds
description: Converts two input coordinates into offsets from a reference point. When the result lies strictly between 48 and 110 horizontally and between 125 and 184 vertically, it calls a handler chosen from a table by a register value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:EB6E
name: clear_bits_in_plane_words
description: Clears bits in eight raster words by ANDing each word with a mask value held in a register.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:EB8E
name: merge_plane_words_pattern_a
description: ORs a value into four of eight raster words and ANDs the other four with a mask value. It is one of several bit-merge patterns applied to a raster record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:EBAE
name: merge_plane_words_pattern_b
description: ORs a value into four of eight raster words and ANDs the other four with a mask value, using a different word pattern. It is one of several bit-merge patterns applied to a raster record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:EBCE
name: merge_plane_words_pattern_c
description: ORs a value into six of eight raster words and ANDs the remaining two with a mask value. It is one of several bit-merge patterns applied to a raster record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:EBEE
name: or_bits_into_plane_words
description: ORs a value into eight raster words of a record, setting the same bits in each word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:EC0E
name: draw_segmented_bar_columns
description: Converts a stored value to a level between zero and 40 and redraws bar columns when the level changes. It sets or clears high-byte bits in three raster planes, and the referenced text 9999 is the upper display limit.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:F822
name: copy_table_words_into_planes
description: Copies words from a table into three raster planes at offsets selected by an input index. It steps through a fixed pattern of row offsets to place each word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:FAC2
name: start_blitter_three_channel_copy
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, programs its source, destination and modulo registers for three channels, and starts a fixed-size transfer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:FBDE
name: expand_nibbles_into_planes
description: Expands packed nibble bytes from a table into 16-bit words in plane buffers. It then shifts a bit row across 40 words and calls routines, and the referenced text 000 is a zero-value display string.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:FD8C
name: shift_bit_rows_and_copy
description: Shifts two rows of eight words right by one bit, carrying the low bit of each word into the next. It then copies 48 words to an output buffer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:FDCC
name: expand_run_table_to_planes
description: Walks a zero-terminated list of four-word groups, looking up nibble values in a table and packing them into 16-bit words. Each packed word is written twice with zeroed words between groups.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:FE3E
name: set_nine_palette_colour_values
description: Writes nine fixed twelve-bit colour values into global colour cells, matching the palette hardware register slots.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:FE88
name: draw_heading_scale_ticks_wide
description: Computes a wrapped angle from a stored value using 360-unit arithmetic and steps of 45. It ORs tick patterns into raster rows across a wide area, with several routine calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:10B62
name: plot_shifted_pattern_in_window
description: Checks that two offsets fall inside a window between 20 and 92 vertically and between 88 and 232 horizontally. It then ORs four shifted pattern words into raster rows at a position derived from the coordinates, and the referenced text is a short symbol string.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:10DBA
name: or_pattern_into_block_a
description: ORs eight pattern words into rows of a raster block at fixed offsets, one word per row column.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:10DBE
name: or_pattern_into_block_b
description: ORs eight pattern words into a larger block of raster rows at fixed offsets, repeating the pattern across several columns.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:15300
name: select_entry_pair_for_position
description: Walks an entry list to find two adjacent entries that are not flagged, copies their values into state cells and sets position values from the first entry scaled by 32. It calls eleven routines during the search and setup.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:155BC
name: initialize_object_record_from_source
description: Initializes an object record from a source record and a stored offset, choosing one of two layouts by a flag bit. It sets size and link fields and stores pointers to two routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:155C0
name: initialize_object_record_variant
description: Initializes an object record from a source record and a stored offset, using the same two layouts as its sibling routine. It sets size and link fields and stores pointers to two routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1567C
name: find_lowest_flagged_entry
description: Scans entries spaced 50 words apart, skipping those with flag bits set. It keeps the entry with the lowest value among those with a nonzero link word, copies that link word into an output and calls a routine for each entry.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:156CA
name: select_entry_from_generator
description: Draws values from a generator in the state block until it finds an entry whose flag bits are clear and whose table value is nonzero. It then calls a routine to finish the selection.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:15784
name: draw_entry_until_flags_match
description: Draws values from a generator in the state block until the chosen entry matches a required flag pattern. It then returns the entry's index together with its flag word.
